def heights(fr):
    a = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    hs={}
    for name,(c0,c1) in {'C1':(0,11),'C2':(15,26),'C3':(30,41),'C4':(45,53),'C5':(57,63)}.items():

    return hs
def click(r,c):

    h1 = heights(current_frame)
    return h0,h1

    print("T4L",i,h1)
for i in range(5):

    print("T3L",i,h1)
h0,h1 = click(40,28)  # T2 w-band again, C3 now 19
print("T2band:",h1)
h0,h1 = click(40,28)
print("T2band2:",h1)
</parameter>
